detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

BPC-157/TB-500 Blend

Chemical Information:
  • BPC-157 Molecular Formula: C62H98N16O22
  • BPC-157 Molecular Weight: 1419.54 g/mol
  • BPC-157 Sequence: Gly-Glu-Pro-Pro-Pro-Gly-Lys-Pro-Ala-Asp-Asp-Ala-Gly-Leu-Val
  • TB-500 Molecular Formula: C212H350N56O78S
  • TB-500 Molecular Weight: 4963.44 g/mol
  • TB-500 Sequence: Ac-Ser-Asp-Lys-Pro-Asp-Met-Ala-Glu-Ile-Glu-Lys-Phe-Asp-Lys-Ser-Lys-Leu-Lys-Lys-Thr-Glu-Thr-Gln-Glu-Lys-Asn-Pro-Leu-Pro-Ser-Lys-Glu-Thr-Ile-Glu-Gln-Glu-Lys-Gln-Ala-Gly-Glu-Ser
  • Molecular Structure: Refer to certificate of analysis for structural details.
Product Description:

BPC-157/TB-500 is a synthetic peptide blend composed of two defined amino acid sequences produced through controlled peptide synthesis. Each component is structurally characterized and combined in a standardized formulation for use in laboratory research environments. The blend is utilized in controlled experimental settings for analytical evaluation of peptide behavior and interaction within defined systems. It is supplied in lyophilized powder form to support stability and integrity during storage and handling.

Research Applications:

The BPC-157/TB-500 blend is utilized in controlled laboratory research settings for applications such as:

  • Analytical evaluation of peptide structure and sequence characteristics
  • Examination of stability and degradation profiles of combined peptide systems
  • Investigation of peptide behavior in biochemical and cell-based assay environments
  • Characterization of interactions between peptide components under controlled experimental conditions
Storage and Handling:
  • Store the lyophilized powder at -20°C.
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2-8°C and use promptly.
  • Use aseptic techniques during handling to maintain sterility and quality.
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

BPC-157/TB-500 is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
